title: derris leucobotrya
intro: Derris leucobotrya, commonly known as the "Fish Poison Tree", is a plant species native to tropical forests in Africa and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Derris leucobotrya include pain relief, wound healing, and the reduction of fever, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
